Aneurysmal Bone Cyst (ABC): The soap-bubble appearance on CT scans and the MRI findings, including hypointensity on T1-weighted images, hyperintensity on T2-weighted images, and avid enhancement on postcontrast sequences, are characteristic of ABCs. The clinical presentation of a painless, well-circumscribed mass in the frontal bone is also consistent with an ABC.
Multiple Myeloma: While multiple myeloma can present with lytic lesions in the bone, the soap-bubble appearance on CT scans is not typical of this condition. Additionally, the MRI findings and the clinical presentation are not as consistent with multiple myeloma as they are with an ABC.
